evals.prompt: The accepted incident-triage workflow has one queue, a selected-incident detail drawer, and one primary action: Assign owner. evals.expected_output: Preserves the accepted workflow and makes the assignment action visually unmistakable; removes or defers nonessential visual layers; records a deliberate no; retains accessibility and necessary state visibility without a literal Steve Jobs imitation.
assertions: Names the user-facing benefit and keeps Assign owner as the visual focal action.
Removes or defers the permanent activity column, hero metric card, nested containers, or animated background unless evidence proves a primary-job need.
States a deliberate no instead of only saying the page should be minimal.
Preserves functional requirements, accessibility, and visible state treatment.
Returns visual-system constraints and an implementation handoff without reauthoring the interaction model.

assertions: Names a visual concept drawn from the bakery or neighborhood world, not only adjectives such as clean, warm, or premium.
